description: This file implements the MigrationPreparer class, which manages migration data storage, component readiness, and reset operations within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace. It includes methods for reading, writing, deleting migration data, handling component readiness files, and resetting data stores.

classes.name: MigrationPreparerImplementation
classes.description: Class responsible for managing migration data, component readiness, and reset operations in the WPEFramework plugin.

methods.name: escapeSed
methods.description: Escapes special characters in strings for sed commands, depending on the sedType (PATTERN or REPLACEMENT).

methods.name: storeKeys
methods.description: Reads and stores keys and values from the data store file into internal data structures.

methods.name: resetDatastore
methods.description: Deletes the data store file and clears internal data structures.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits a string into a list based on a delimiter.

methods.name: join
methods.description: Joins a list of strings into a single string separated by a delimiter.

methods.name: isDuplicate
methods.description: Checks if a string exists in a list.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes or updates a key-value pair in the migration data store.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads a value associated with a key from the data store.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a key-value pair from the data store.

methods.name: setComponentReadiness
methods.description: Adds a component name to the component readiness file in sorted order.

methods.name: getComponentReadiness
methods.description: Retrieves the list of components marked as ready.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the data store and/or migration readiness file based on reset type.
